notes.title: Upcoming Update (Multiplayer Region Non-Cross Compatible Edition)
notes.content:
So with the closed testing phase having taken place for a couple days we have arrived at a passable connection in multiplayer.

This connection allows "Your Region" and is not able to connect to other people's region.
so if you are from a different country you can't play with them or if you are from another set of states not in the same region you can't play together but!!!...

You can play with people within your region meaning a couple of other states nearby. It's localized region compatible.

Say you are both on the same region but different states in the USA or other outlying country region. but different states nearby it.
Yes, you can play together. ^-^

So now let me fix up some more networked objects for it to be a playful experience.

Welcome to the world of Ascoria or whatever you want it to be called lol.
